minimum_safe_route_predicate: Recovery does not require both historical-result-verification and replay-deduplication horizons to remain valid simultaneously.

At least one currently valid route must be complete for the intended decision: it must both avoid an unsupported second irreversible effect and provide a provider-verifiable terminal result/effect identity sufficient for exact F5 CAS finalization.
A live result-query route can satisfy the predicate without any live replay guarantee because no replay is needed.

A live idempotent-replay route can satisfy the predicate without live historical-result proof only if replay is guaranteed duplicate-safe for exact O5,D5,I5 and reconstructs a terminal result/effect identity.
If no single currently valid route satisfies both safety and terminal reconstruction, fail closed and preserve unresolved state.

weak_rule_falsified.rule: Safe recovery requires both current historical-result verification and current replay/deduplication guarantees to remain valid at the same time.
weak_rule_falsified.falsification: Branch B recovers safely through a live exact terminal-result query without replay, so expired deduplication is irrelevant. Branch A can recover safely through a live duplicate-safe replay only when that replay also reconstructs a terminal result. Therefore the minimum contract is one currently valid complete safe reconstruction route, not simultaneous survival of both horizon classes.

observations: The two horizon classes are substitutable only at the route level, not as bare booleans. A surviving horizon is useful only when its route yields enough terminal evidence for current F5 finalization without risking a second irreversible effect.
A live result-query route is strictly preferable when replay deduplication has expired because it avoids creating a new effect attempt.
A live deduplication horizon alone is not equivalent to recoverability if the replay response cannot reconstruct a terminal result/effect identity.
inference: For this exact self-local trace, the minimum safe recurring-Chat recovery contract is disjunctive: one currently valid complete reconstruction route is enough. The route may be a live exact terminal-result query/proof, or a live exact idempotent replay that both prevents duplicate effects and reconstructs a terminal result. Requiring both horizon classes simultaneously is stronger than necessary, while accepting either horizon without route completeness is unsafe.
